import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.themoviedb.org/3"
API_KEY = "YOUR_TMDB_API_KEY"

response = requests.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/search/person",
    params={"api_key": API_KEY, "query": "Sofia Coppola"},
)
response.raise_for_status()
people = response.json().get("results", [])
person = next((p for p in people if p.get("name") == "Sofia Coppola"), None)

if person is None:
    print(0)
else:
    response = requests.get(
        f"{BASE_URL}/person/{person['id']}/movie_credits",
        params={"api_key": API_KEY},
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    credits = response.json()
    print(sum(1 for movie in credits.get("crew", []) if movie.get("job") == "Director"))
